title: Week One Boss
topic: Boss Battle: Week 1 algebra mix (two-step, both sides, distributing, fractions)

scenes.sub: Every move from this week, one fight
scenes.say: Math Blitz, day seven! It's Boss Battle day! Everything you learned this week, all in one equation. Double XP on the line. Let's go!

scenes.heading: THE BOSS PLAYBOOK
scenes.say: Here's the playbook. Clear the fractions. Distribute. Get x on one side. Finish it. Four moves, every time.

scenes.heading: WARM-UP ROUND
scenes.say: x plus one, over two, plus x, equals two times x minus one. Times two, everybody! Now distribute. Three x plus one equals four x minus four.

scenes.heading: FINISH + READ TWICE
scenes.say: Slide the x's together. x equals five! Now the SAT trap: read the question again. If they ask for two x, the answer is ten, not five.

scenes.ask: What is the value of x/2?
scenes.say: Boss time, champ! Fifty XP on the line. Two times x minus one, over three, plus x over two, equals x plus one. Careful, they want x over two! Tap your answer below the video!

question.prompt: 2(x − 1)/3 + x/2 = x + 1. What is the value of x/2?
question.explain: Multiply every term by 6: 4(x − 1) + 3x = 6x + 6, so 7x − 4 = 6x + 6 and x = 10. The question asks for x/2, so the answer is 5.

trap_notes.0: Forgot to multiply the 1 on the right by 6 (7x − 4 = 6x + 1 gives x = 5)
trap_notes.1: Didn't distribute: wrote 4x − 1 instead of 4x − 4 (gives x = 7)
trap_notes.3: Found x = 10 but answered x instead of x/2

rapid.prompt: Plan A: $20 plus $4 per GB. Plan B: $8 per GB, no fee. At how many GB do they cost the same?

rapid.why: 3x + 6 = x + 18 → 2x = 12 → 2x − 1 = 11. No need to find x!
